subject.title: feat(ui): Swarm progress widget — dot grid per swarm group (#110325)

question: Should the Control UI board model adopt `contentKind: "builtin"` for ephemeral native operational cards, beginning with the swarm-progress card, rather than keeping swarm progress outside the board-widget abstraction?
rationale: The patch introduces a reusable native rendering category and virtual read-only board entities; implementation quality alone cannot establish whether that is the desired long-term Control UI boundary.

options.title: Accept native board cards
options.body: Approve `builtin` as the Control UI extension point for read-only ephemeral operational cards, with the swarm card as its first use.

options.title: Keep swarm outside board widgets
options.body: Request a dedicated swarm dashboard surface so persisted-board concepts and native operational status remain separate.

options.title: Defer the abstraction
options.body: Pause this PR until an owner defines the intended native-card contract and future uses.

recommendation.title: Accept native board cards
recommendation.body: Approve `builtin` as the Control UI extension point for read-only ephemeral operational cards, with the swarm card as its first use.

likelyOwner.reason: The related Swarm proposal and this branch establish the strongest available ownership signal for the intended product boundary.
